There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for a Dallas truck accident case based on these results, but the strongest candidates from the search are **Zehl & Associates**, **Grossman Law Offices**, **Mullen & Mullen**, and **Frank L. Branson’s firm**, since they are all prominently listed for truck-accident or personal-injury work in Dallas and tout significant results or recognition.[1][7][9][12][14]

If you want the most case-specific pick from the results, **Zehl & Associates** and **Grossman Law Offices** stand out for truck-accident focus: Zehl advertises Dallas truck/18-wheeler representation and “we’re undefeated,” while Grossman says it is among the most accomplished Texas firms handling difficult truck accident claims involving serious injuries and death.[1][12]

For a broader personal-injury firm with strong Dallas recognition, **Mullen & Mullen** is notable because it says it has been featured by *Newsweek* and named Top Injury Law Firm in Dallas by Top Choice Awards for eight consecutive years.[9][14]

If you’re choosing one firm, the best practical next step is to compare:
- **Truck-accident trial experience**

- **Who will actually handle your case**
